sloka: हनूमान्रामकार्यार्थं भीमकर्मा खमाप्लुतः ।अस्य साह्यं मया कार्यमिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्तिनः ॥५-१-९६॥
transliteration: hanūmānrāmakāryārthaṁ bhīmakarmā khamāplutaḥ ।asya sāhyaṁ mayā kāryamikṣvākukulavartinaḥ ॥5-1-96॥

translations.english: "I should help him for he is working for the welfare of the Ikshavaku family. The Ikshvaku kings are worthy of adoration to me and for you as well.
